claims.text: Mirabella was one of the Old Took's many children, and his youngest daughter. She married Gorbadoc Brandybuck, and had seven children: Rorimac, Amaranth, Saradas, Dodinas, Asphodel, Dinodas and Primula.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Took of Great Smials"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Brandybuck of Buckland"
